name: Varna
title: Varna Ship Thickness Measurement | UTM for Black Sea Ships
description: Ultrasonic thickness measurement in Varna for bulk carriers and general cargo ships: hull structure gauging, renewal survey and pre-docking UTM.
h1: Ultrasonic Thickness Measurement and Hull Gauging in Varna
intro: Varna is the centre of Bulgarian dry-bulk ship management and the place where many Black Sea grain and fertiliser carriers go for repair. If your bulk carrier or general cargo ship is working cargo at Port Varna East or Varna West, or is booked into one of the city's repair yards, a gauging team mobilised from India meets it, lays out measurement points against the survey scope and hands over records the attending surveyor can work from.

highlights.h: Two repair yards in the city
highlights.p: Varna has two established repair yards, MTG Dolphin and Odessos Shiprepair Yard. A drydock stay at either is the window to gauge bottom plating, sea chests and side shell before the steel list is fixed.

Bulk carriers loading fertilisers at Varna West, and grain ships worked hard by grabs, show wastage on hold frames, lower brackets, hopper plating and hatch coamings. Gauging maps it before the next renewal survey does.

Bulgaria has been a full Schengen member since January 2025, so the team travels on Schengen visas. We start the application once the yard slot or loading window is firm and share the visa timeline with you.

port.h: Varna's two port areas and their shipping
p: The Port of Varna works from two separate areas. Varna East sits in the city on Varna Bay and handles general cargo, containers and project cargo. Varna West lies inland at the far end of the lake and canal system, close to the Devnya industrial zone, and is the bulk side of the port: grain, fertilisers, soda ash, cement and other dry cargoes cross its berths. Ships bound for Varna West, and for most repair berths, pass through the canals that join Lake Varna to the sea, so a single call can combine cargo work, a yard stay and lay-by time within a short distance of each other.

Varna is also home to Navigation Maritime Bulgare, the country's main dry-bulk owner, to a cluster of crewing agencies and ship-management companies, and to the Nikola Vaptsarov Naval Academy. For managers in the city, a ship calling at its home port is the easiest moment for a superintendent to attend the gauging in person and walk the holds with the team. Grain loading follows the Bulgarian harvest, and ships waiting at the Varna Bay anchorage for a berth or for cargo can have idle days that suit tank and hold gauging.

What sets inspection demand apart here is the age and employment of the tonnage. Black Sea grain, fertiliser and steel trades have long been worked by older bulk carriers and general cargo ships, and once a ship reaches its third renewal survey, the required close-up survey and thickness measurement in holds and ballast tanks rise sharply. Fertiliser residues and moisture attack hold frames and lower brackets, grabs gouge tank-top and hopper plating, and hatch covers take years of wave loading on short-sea passages. The result is steady demand for gauging that tells an owner, before the yard submits its repair offer, how much steel the next survey is likely to need.

facilities.h: Where ships are gauged in and around Varna
p: The two repair yards are the natural places for a full gauging programme. MTG Dolphin combines ship repair with newbuilding work, and Odessos Shiprepair Yard concentrates on repair and drydocking. In dock, the team can reach bottom and bilge plating, the sea chests and the lower side shell, while staging rigged for the repair gives reach to the upper frames in the holds and to hatch cover undersides that would otherwise need a cherry-picker. Gauging in the first days of the stay, before staging is moved, lets the yard and class agree the renewal list from measured figures rather than estimates.

Outside the yards, gauging is done afloat. At Varna West the holds of a bulk carrier can be measured after discharge and before loading, and ballast tanks can be entered whenever the chief officer has them ventilated and the entry permit signed. At Varna East and at the bay anchorage, the usual scope is deck plating, hatch coamings, air pipes and ventilators, deck piping and whichever tanks are empty, with the work fitted around cargo operations, bunkering and any port state control visit. Each location has its own access rules, and the plan is written around them before the team travels.
list: MTG Dolphin — Varna ship repair and newbuilding yard; drydock stays give access to bottom, bilge and side shell plating for renewal-survey gauging.
Odessos Shiprepair Yard — repair and drydocking yard in Varna; suited to pre-repair gauging of holds, ballast tanks and hatch covers while the yard's staging is in place.
Port Varna West — bulk berths near Devnya; empty holds between discharge and loading allow frame, bracket and hopper plating to be gauged.
Port Varna East — city terminal for general cargo and containers; deck, hatch coaming and deck-piping gauging during the cargo call.
Varna Bay anchorage — ships waiting for a berth or cargo; ballast tank and deck gauging with launch access arranged through the ship's agent.

context.h: Port state control, emissions rules and Black Sea trading conditions
p: Bulgaria, as an EU member state, inspects ships under the EU port state control directive and holds membership of both the Paris MoU and the Black Sea MoU. On older bulk carriers, structural findings such as wasted hatch coamings, holed air pipes and corroded deck fittings can turn a routine inspection into a deficiency to be rectified before departure, with class called in and repairs agreed before the ship sails. Having measured thicknesses on file, or having them taken while the ship is still alongside, gives the owner and the class surveyor the figures they need to settle on a permanent or temporary repair.

No emission control area covers the Black Sea, which leaves ships at sea on the global 0.50% sulphur cap; at a Bulgarian berth, though, EU law requires fuel of 0.10% sulphur or less, or an equivalent abatement method. Voyages to and from Varna are covered by the EU ETS, which has applied to shipping since 2024, and by FuelEU Maritime since 2025; both now sit alongside steel condition in decisions about whether to keep, retrofit or sell an older ship. Trading conditions in the Black Sea have changed since the war in Ukraine began in 2022, with routing and war-risk cover set by owners and underwriters. That affects voyage planning more than gauging alongside in Varna, and we follow the owner's security guidance when scheduling attendance.

jobs.h: Typical thickness gauging jobs in Varna
jobs.p: Requests for ship inspection in Varna tend to follow the bulk trades and the repair calendar. The jobs below are the patterns that fit the port's mix of yard stays, cargo windows and anchorage waits. Each is scoped from the ship's survey status, the class requirements for thickness measurement at that survey and the access the yard or terminal can give, and the plan is confirmed with the superintendent before anyone travels.
list: Third renewal survey of a handysize bulk carrier at a Varna yard: hold frames, hopper and topside tanks, hatch covers and coamings gauged early so the steel list is agreed before cropping starts.
Pre-docking gauging in Varna Bay on a supramax lying at anchorage a few weeks before its yard slot, giving the owner measured wastage to order steel and plan the yard period against.
Re-gauging at an annual survey of areas recorded with substantial corrosion at the last renewal, carried out in empty holds at Varna West between discharge and loading.
Condition gauging for a buyer inspecting a general cargo ship for purchase, covering deck, hatch cover, hold and shell plating while the vessel lies alongside in Varna.
Ballast and fire-main pipe wall measurement during a repair stay, mapping thinning on deck and engine-room lines so pipe renewal is ordered once, in the right lengths.

logistics: The team flies into Varna Airport, or into Sofia for wider international connections and onward travel to the coast. The repair yards and the Port Varna terminals are ISPS facilities, so gate passes for the technicians and their equipment are requested through the ship's agent or the yard's security department with passport details in advance; at the anchorage, the agent books the launch. Because Bulgaria is in the Schengen area, the team needs Schengen visas, and we schedule mobilisation from India around the visa decision as well as the ship's arrival, so tell us the yard or ETA window as early as you can.

faqs.q: Can you gauge a bulk carrier at a Varna yard before the repair specification is fixed?
faqs.a: Yes, and that is the most useful timing. If the team gauges at the start of the stay, the yard and the class surveyor can agree the renewal list from measured figures, and steel can be ordered once. Send us the last thickness measurement report, the survey status and the yard dates, and we will lay out the measurement points before the team leaves India.

faqs.q: Do you offer thickness measurement in Bulgaria outside Varna?
faqs.a: Yes. The same team can attend ships at Burgas, at the Rosenets oil terminal and at anchorages along the Bulgarian coast, and can continue to Constanța in Romania if a fleet has several ships in the area. Grouping calls on one mobilisation makes better use of the Schengen visas and the travel from India.

faqs.q: Can gauging continue while the ship loads grain at Varna West?
faqs.a: Holds cannot be gauged once cargo is in them, so hold work has to happen between discharge and loading or before the first hatch opens. Ballast tanks, the deck, hatch coamings and deck piping can usually be measured during loading, provided the chief officer agrees tank entry and the work stays clear of the stevedores and the cargo gear.

faqs.q: How far ahead should we book UTM in Varna for a drydock?
faqs.a: The moment the yard slot is firm. The limiting step is the Schengen visa for technicians travelling from India, not the gauging itself, so early notice lets us fix travel dates around the docking. If the docking moves, tell us straight away and we re-plan the mobilisation to match the new dates.
